notes.title: Now the game supports fullscreen mode!
notes.content:
- How to switch display mode and to end the game
You can switch between fullscreen mode and windowed mode by pressing Alt key and Enter key together. While in fullscreen mode, you can end the game by pressing Alt key and F4 key together.
